title: Welcome to the Big Data Section!

cues.en: Now that we've covered data science at a scale that fits on a local computer it's time to start talking about big data with SPARK.
cues.zh: 我們已經介紹能在本機電腦上處理的資料科學，現在該開始討論使用 Spark 的大數據了。

cues.en: Spark is one of the latest emerging technologies for big data and in some of the most popular libraries used for Python and big data in order to actually use SPARC will have to show you how to get set up
cues.zh: Spark 是大數據領域較新興的技術之一，也是 Python 與大數據領域最熱門的函式庫之一；為了實際使用 Spark，我們必須示範如何，
在 Amazon Web Services 上設定環境。

cues.en: We'll go ahead and go through this in the next lecture.
Thanks everyone and I'll see you there.
